Trace, implement and test: 面试题68 II. 二叉树的最近公共祖先

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */

class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode* root, TreeNode* p, TreeNode* q) {
        // 如果找到val，层层向上传递该root
        if (nullptr == root || p->val == root->val || q->val == root->val) {
            return root;
        }

        TreeNode* left = lowestCommonAncestor(root->left, p, q);
        TreeNode* right = lowestCommonAncestor(root->right, p, q);

        if (left != nullptr && right != nullptr) {
            // 如果两边都可以找到
            return root;
        } else if (left == nullptr) {
            // 如果左边没有找到，则直接返回右边内容
            return right;
        } else {
            return left;
        }
    }
};
